children: Calgary, Canada – September 9, 2026 – TheNewswire – Onco-Innovations Limited (CBOE CA: ONCO) (OTCQB: ONNVF) (Frankfurt: W1H, WKN: A3EKSZ) ("Onco" or the "Company”) is pleased to announce, further to its news release dated June 26, 2026, that it has received interim results from the ongoing three-species liver microsome metabolism studies supporting the preclinical development of ONC010, the Company's lead nanoparticle-formulated PNKP inhibitor. The studies are evaluating the metabolism of A83B4C63, ONC010's active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), across human, rat and dog test systems. The original program was initiated to characterize intrinsic clearance, metabolic degradation pathways and species-specific metabolism.

The interim results indicate that A83B4C63 is metabolized in all three species evaluated, primarily through pathways characteristic of cytochrome P450 enzymes, with species differences in the rate of metabolism observed. System controls performed as expected across all three species. The Company intends to conduct additional metabolite characterization work, including enzyme phenotyping, as the program advances. The interim findings were consistent with expectations and did not identify findings that would preclude continuation of the planned preclinical development program.

The studies are being conducted by Nucro-Technics Inc. ("Nucro-Technics") as part of the Company's broader preclinical development program for ONC010. As previously announced, the program is designed to characterize intrinsic clearance, metabolic degradation pathways and species-specific metabolism to help inform future toxicology studies, pharmacokinetic modelling, dose selection and regulatory planning. The use of both hepatocytes (results pending) and liver microsomes is intended to provide complementary information, allowing broader cell-based metabolic activity to be considered alongside more enzyme-focused metabolism.

The Company believes the interim findings are consistent with the anticipated progression of the program and support the continuation of the planned preclinical work for ONC010. The initial API microsome study results are being finalized, the API hepatocyte study results are pending, and additional testing will evaluate how the polymeric nanoparticle component of ONC010 is degraded as well. The metabolism studies form part of Nucro-Technics' broader work supporting Onco's preclinical development program, which includes bioanalytical method development, pharmacokinetics, biodistribution, toxicology and three-species metabolism studies.

"These interim findings provide us with an important early view of the metabolic profile of A83B4C63 across the species being evaluated in our preclinical program. The results observed to date are consistent with our expectations and provide additional information to support the continued progression of the planned preclinical development program for ONC010," stated Dr. Islam Mohamed, Chief Medical Officer of Onco-Innovations.

"The interim results add to the body of data being generated as we systematically advance ONC010 through preclinical development. We are encouraged that the program continues to progress in accordance with our development plan, as we work to build the scientific and regulatory foundation needed to support ONC010's continued advancement," stated Thomas O'Shaughnessy, Chief Executive Officer of Onco-Innovations.

Onco-Innovations is a Canadian-based company dedicated to cancer research and treatment, specializing in oncology. Onco’s mission is to pursue the prevention and treatment of cancer through pioneering research and innovative solutions. The company has secured an exclusive worldwide license to patented technology that targets solid tumours.
